title: REASONING OVER BOUNDARIES: ENHANCING SPECIFICATION ALIGNMENT VIA TEST-TIME DELIBERATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge to check compliance with scenario-specific safety and behavioral specifications that explicitly prohibit sexist remarks and assumptions about gender.
Evaluating model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge to check compliance with scenario-specific safety specifications that explicitly prohibit racist remarks and discriminatory language toward any race.

Evaluating model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge against behavioral specifications that require portraying different cultures or regions without stereotypes, and prohibiting discriminatory remarks about cultural practices.
Evaluating model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge against safety specifications that mandate maintaining respect toward all ages and prohibiting hateful or insulting language.
Evaluating model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge against safety specifications that require maintaining respect toward all religions and prohibiting discriminatory language.
Evaluating model outputs using an LLM-as-a-judge to check compliance with behavioral and safety specifications that prohibit assumptions about ability and mandate respect toward all abilities.
